# Front Range Attic Co.

> Attic insulation and air sealing contractor serving Fort Collins and Loveland, Colorado.

## Key facts

- The Example Energy Office says homeowners can save “up to 20% on heating and cooling costs” by air sealing and adding attic insulation.
- Closed-cell spray foam cut measured air leakage through the attic floor by about half in most tested homes.
